- Filter-based updates apply the same values to all matching records and evaluate filter conditions when the update runs. Updates that also require changes to relationships must still use record-based updates.

- Improved the security of key management.

## Feature Updates
- Added the read-only MCP query-data tool for structured record retrieval, filtering, pagination, aggregation, grouping, and bucketing without SQL. Queries follow existing access controls, and unsupported capabilities return explicit errors. The behavior of the existing sql-query and get-records tools remains unchanged.

## Feature Updates
- DATETIME_DIFF with day or days now returns the number of whole elapsed days truncated toward zero and uses the formula’s time zone to avoid one-day discrepancies caused by daylight saving time transitions. To retain fractional results in existing formulas, set the fourth argument to TRUE.

## Feature Updates
- Formulas created through the CLI and AI now use the time zones of the date fields they reference, ensuring accurate calculations for `TODAY()`, countdowns, and similar operations. Explicitly configured formula time zones still take precedence.

## Feature Updates
- Field deletion and conversion previews now show affected apps, queries, fields, and data sources, distinguishing published and latest-saved versions. Saved queries report healthy, drifted, or broken status with clearer explanations. Previews remain read-only, require confirmation before changes, and do not automatically modify affected apps.

## Feature Updates
- Added a mobile app download option to the user menu.
- Added custom domain support for published apps on self-hosted instances.
- Added instance-wide OIDC configuration for App Builder, enabling apps to offer “Continue with SSO” alongside existing sign-in methods.
- Simplified personal access token configuration with four permission presets, grouped read/write permissions, searchable individual permissions, and clearer access coverage. Token lists now show presets, support expiratio

- Routines now run as their owners, and generated artifacts and run conversations belong to those owners. Publishing, activating, or running an inactive Routine may transfer ownership to the user performing the action; sandbox resources, credentials, and quotas remain bound to the Routine.

- Added read-only impact previews for field deletion and type conversion, table deletion and duplication, record pasting and bulk updates, and database duplication. Previews show blockers, warnings, dependencies, and unknowns, and are also available through the HTTP API and authenticated integrations. Current inputs and permissions are still validated when operations are submitted.
